title: Empat Puluh Kunci
genre: Brunei-Malay traditional pop fusion (Aziz Harun lane)
subject: a tenant locked out in the evening and an elderly landlord arriving with a ring of forty unlabelled keys, trying every one on the grille door while they chat
caption: Brunei-Malay traditional pop fusion, Bornean Malay ornament in a modern pop song. Bright gulintangan gong-chime melodies, two gendang drums in a lilting adai-adai style pattern, plucked gambus lute fills, strummed acoustic guitar and a soft round synth bass. Clean modern pop production with the traditional percussion forward and warm reverb. Male tenor with smooth melismatic Malay pop phrasing and light ornaments. 98 BPM, G minor. Patient, amused and gently exasperated. No autotune, no trap beat, no EDM drop, no rock guitars, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - gulintangan and gambus, gendang enters]

[Verse 1]
Pukul lapan, aku tertinggal kunci
Duduk depan pintu, beg di riba
Tuan rumah datang naik motor
Bawa segugus, bunyi macam loceng

[Pre-Chorus]
Yang ini rasanya, katanya
Tak juga, cuba yang lain

[Chorus]
Empat puluh kunci
Satu-satu dia cuba
Sambil cerita anak di Miri
Kunci ketiga belas pun tak kena

[Verse 2]
Kucing oren datang duduk sebelah
Dia pun tunggu pintu terbuka
Nyamuk datang, lampu berkelip
Kunci kedua puluh, hampir masuk

[Pre-Chorus]
Pakcik ketawa, aku pun sama
Malam masih panjang

[Chorus]
Empat puluh kunci
Yang terakhir, baru terbuka
Dia kata, minggu depan
Kita tulis nombor, kita tampal nama

[Outro - gambus and gong-chimes fade]
